item.title: Correction · Community Center Garage (UCSF Mission Bay): The garage record said a real rooftop deck with painted striping was visible in satellite imagery, that it stood beside the William J. Rutter Community Center and was joined by a walkway, and that the area was the 1625 Owens St parking lot. UCSF's June 2025 CAC map supports only an existing garage labeled 'Community Center Garage (21A)' beside 'Rutter Center (21B)'. The record now says so, marks the rooftop deck, walkway and striping as Pier & Point's own satellite reading (not cited), drops the full Rutter Center name, and flags that the 1625 Owens St address is unsourced.

item.title: Milestone · Community Center Garage (UCSF Mission Bay): UC Regents Committee on Grounds and Buildings item (May 17, 2000) for the Mission Bay community center building says an 'interim parking lot will be developed at the northwest corner of the building until a parking structure can be built in a later phase of campus development'; the item is about the community center, not the garage (May 2000)
